panels.description: Alex jumps backward and knocks over a stool, hands half-raised. Bi11bot dusts off his shoulders in the foreground and turns toward him. Keep both silhouettes readable and reserve the upper third for dialogue.
Bi11bot’s amber eyes narrow to focus; the heavy rings rotate with a click and his head tilts patiently. Keep the face clear and reserve separate upper-left and upper-right dialogue zones.

Bi11bot looks toward the watch on Alex’s left wrist. Alex briefly unfastens and rotates it to expose the looping equation on the caseback; Bi11bot’s mustard hand hovers above it without touching. Show the strap still looped around Alex’s left wrist. Keep equation and chalkboard unobstructed; reserve the upper third for dialogue.

Alex immediately refastens the watch on his left wrist as a small projector unfolds from Bi11bot’s shoulder. Soft-blue light falls across Alex’s face and the workshop drops into shadow. Reserve the upper-left for the projector SFX and upper-right for the final balloon.

items.speaker: BI11BOT
items.text: You're taller than your father predicted.

items.speaker: ALEX
items.text: Everyone in Keel claims they knew my father.

items.speaker: BI11BOT
items.text: Most of them knew his reputation. I knew his mistakes.

items.speaker: BI11BOT
items.text: He wanted you to know the true cost of your decisions.

items.speaker: BI11BOT
items.text: Now. Shall we say hello to your father?
